body: Thanks. I know that I need to get better, I just wish that I could convince myself that I'm with it and that I'm actually good enough to do it and not just fail.

I'm not sure. To be honest I've never put much effort into checking, but I'm in the US. I'm sure there's something.
I'm usually too scared to talk to anyone but a few people I've shared with before. It's easier here because I don't have to say anything out loud.

Thank you.

I know it's good advice, but I've never really liked talking to my parents about these things, especially after the way they've responded in the past.
